english.title: Use vehicle carrying load / appliance / apparatus rear projection exceeding 2m but less than 3.05m not properly marked

english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 82(7) of the Road Vehicles (Construction and Use) Regulations 1986, section 42 of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

english.notes:
(i) Regulation 82(7) does not apply to straddle carriers.
(ii) Statement of Facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
(iii) See also offence wordings: H3352 and H3353.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level four on the standard scale if in respect of goods vehicle or vehicle adapted to carry more than eight passengers.

A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale in any other case.

Fixed penalty ticket - Fifty pounds.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
